# Original Java SqlSplitter cases

`original.json` contains 69 cases generated by `tests/java/SqlScriptGolden.java`
against the unchanged Java `SqlSplitter.java` in the read-only original checkout,
under Java 25 with the original application's dependencies and zh-CN locale.

Fixture SHA-256: `7A962830D23892A34B5DC989C31A0A29D936E4AF98C8AEAD9F5CADA8547E75DF`.
Original SqlSplitter SHA-256:
`32476B81F6BF88EBA2D6218184F0107100D9BC45CEDA8DD702DF28A9855E1ED9`.

Cases cover the original comment/quote state machine, semicolon splitting,
statement classification and source-table extraction, including the original
backtick/dollar-quote limitations and Unicode uppercase indexing exception.
The Rust parser borrows statement slices instead of cloning the full script
into a list. A source-table extraction error disables that result's edit mapping;
it does not invent a physical table from an expression or alias.
